name: io.github.joaoh82/rustunnel
title: rustunnel
description: Expose any localhost service so an AI agent can reach it — public HTTPS/TCP/UDP URLs via six MCP tools. Open source, self-hostable.

packageArguments.name: --server
packageArguments.description: rustunnel control-plane address (your own host:4040 when self-hosting)

packageArguments.name: --api
packageArguments.description: rustunnel dashboard REST API base URL

environmentVariables.name: RUSTUNNEL_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token from rustunnel.com → Dashboard → API Keys (or your self-hosted admin token)
